230.name: Shadowstitch
230.description:
The afflicted is prevented from moving due to the Shadowstitch Ninjutsu.
This ailment cannot be removed by dispelling Negative Effects.

231.name: Curse of the Enlightened
231.description:
Some enemies that appear on Enlightened One's Journey will spawn with this Status Enhancement, which cannot be removed. Its effects vary based on enemy type:
• Human enemies will consume less Ki when attacking.
• Yokai enemies will take less Ki damage.

Successful Burst Breaks, weak point destruction, Final Blows, and Grapples will temporarily nullify the Curse's effects. The duration of nullification varies based on which of these methods you used to nullify the Curse.

232.name: Curse of the Nioh
232.description:
Some enemies that appear on Nioh's Journey will spawn with this status enhancement, which cannot be removed. Its effects include:
- Increased Ki damage dealt.
- Regain Life when dealing damage.
- Humans consume less Ki when attacking.
- Yokai receive reduced Ki damage.

Successful Burst Breaks, weak point destruction, Final Blows, and Grapples will temporarily nullify the Curse's effects. The duration of nullification varies based on which of these methods you used to nullify the Curse.
